features.purpose: Selected/highlight marker depth, fixed geographic tip and reduced-motion transitions.
features.authorizationImplications: Marker appearance cannot imply verification, recommendation or sponsorship.
features.uiImplications: Reauthor for Mapbox; no MapLibre shaders/lifecycle code.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Anchored tip, focus dominance, marker/card parity, fallback, reduced motion.

features.purpose: Media → identity → essential context → record actions → detail.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: LensResultCardModel and shared participant card primitives.
features.dataImplications: No donor fixture media; only authorized RFxchange media references.
features.authorizationImplications: Card actions and favorites remain domain-authorized.
features.uiImplications: Adapt hierarchy, density and fallback logic to current card model.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Accessibility, five locales, media failure, no autoplay sound, continuity.

features.purpose: One icon language detached from domain registry implementation details.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Participant lens registry plus shared icon adapter.
features.authorizationImplications: Decorative icons do not replace text/accessibility labels.
features.uiImplications: Port semantic identity and visual quality; avoid raw donor registry coupling.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Repository-wide legacy-glyph guard, optical balance, mobile/desktop parity.

features.purpose: Use restrained ownership treatment instead of repetitive metadata.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Server-authorized organization association on shared card projections.
features.dataImplications: No donor ownedByViewer field becomes authority.
features.authorizationImplications: Ownership comes from current membership/organization context.
features.uiImplications: Adapt gold/accent treatment only after server-derived ownership.
features.acceptanceCriteria: No synthetic search result, no count distortion, screen-reader truth.

features.purpose: Keep lens-wide controls at sheet top and record workflows on cards/detail.
features.uiImplications: Adapt visual separation without changing action IDs or commands.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Exactly four lens actions; bounded record actions; disabled state truth.

features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Account/Menu utility and existing authorized routes.
features.dataImplications: No donor browser state becomes canonical.
features.authorizationImplications: Every leaf revalidates current permissions; destructive actions remain server-controlled.
features.uiImplications: Compare hierarchy against actual RFxchange destinations; do not import dead leaves.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Back/Escape, deep state, no internal language, authorized destinations only.

features.purpose: Remove architecture metadata, explanatory cards and internal language.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Future Account/Menu presentation over existing routes.
features.uiImplications: Port row-based hierarchy and concise copy after route comparison.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Accessible nested navigation, localization, no hidden unavailable behavior.

features.purpose: Logo, approved provider link, poster and optional hosted short intro.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: INF-008 storedAssets private source objects plus future public media projection.
features.dataImplications: Do not copy SQL media rows or URLs; normalize provider metadata and migrate only reviewed real media.
features.authorizationImplications: Organization profile manage permission; provider/duration verification; private source object.
features.uiImplications: Rebuild editor and card fallback against Firebase Storage/public projection.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Storage emulator, ownership, allowlist, duration, public projection, card fallback.

features.rfxchangeEquivalent: Domain-specific commands, relations, referral aggregate and shared return context.
features.dataImplications: No generic TestRFx relationship table migrates as canonical truth.
features.authorizationImplications: Each command is domain-specific and revalidates membership/record state.
features.uiImplications: Only presentation/launch patterns may be reused.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Idempotency, negative tenant cases, event/audit, safe return.

features.purpose: Issuer and responder child/grandchild workflow organization.
features.rfxchangeEquivalent: RFx aggregate/package/definition/publication and staged Slice 4.7–4.10 packet chain.
features.dataImplications: No SQL workspace or exchange_record migration.
features.authorizationImplications: Commands must be server-authorized and lifecycle/version checked.
features.uiImplications: Use hierarchy as UX/process reference; current RFx domain remains authority.
features.acceptanceCriteria: Domain command coverage, version conflicts, tenant isolation, five locales.
